# tapectl location

[All commands](README.md)

Manage storage locations

```text
tapectl location [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

**Subcommands**

- [`add`](#tapectl-location-add) — Add a storage location
- [`list`](#tapectl-location-list) — List locations
- [`info`](#tapectl-location-info) — Show location details
- [`rename`](#tapectl-location-rename) — Rename a location

### tapectl location add

Add a storage location

```text
tapectl location add [OPTIONS] <NAME>
```

**Arguments**

- `<NAME>` — Location name (e.g., "home-rack", "parents-house")

**Options**

- `-d, --description <DESCRIPTION>` — Description. For a warehouse this is where the endpoint or prefix goes (e.g. "s3://bucket/prefix") -- there is deliberately no separate URI column
- `--kind <KIND>` *(default: `shelf`; one of `shelf`, `warehouse`)* — Kind of location (ADR-0006). A `shelf` holds physical cartridges; a `warehouse` is cold cloud storage that can only receive recorded deposits (`volume deposit add`)

### tapectl location list

List locations

```text
tapectl location list [OPTIONS]
```

### tapectl location info

Show location details

```text
tapectl location info [OPTIONS] <NAME>
```

**Arguments**

- `<NAME>` — Location name

### tapectl location rename

Rename a location

```text
tapectl location rename [OPTIONS] <CURRENT> <NEW>
```

**Arguments**

- `<CURRENT>` — Current name
- `<NEW>` — New name
